_how_to: Published newsletter issues, shown on /newsletter/ (newest first) and as /newsletter/<id>/ in every language. Per issue: <id>/issue.html (the issue text as HTML, English), optional <id>/thumbnail.png (video poster), <id>/subs.vtt (English subtitles) and the video: <id>/video.mp4 is NOT committed (see .gitignore); build.py copies it into site/newsletter/<id>/ once (all languages use that copy) and, when the local file is missing, downloads video.url and checks video.sha256. Source drafts: newsletter/issues/.
